headline: Carney BLASTS Trump's TARIFF Attack! 🔥🇨🇦💥
text:
Canada's 🏁 PRIME 🕴️ MINISTER'S Mark 🍁 CARNEY 🍑 DADDY 🐺 straight 🧍‍♂️ up ☝️ said 🗣️ he 👤 was 🕳️ RELUCTANTLY 🥀 ANNOUNCING 📢 RETALIATORY 💥 tariffs 💰 after he ACCUSED 🇺🇸 the US of STARTING 🏭 a TRADE 💼 WAR 🪖 and then 🕰️ went on 📖 to call 📣 the fresh 🌱 WAVE 🌊 of US tariffs on Canada 🇨🇦 a misCOCKulation 🍆 designed 🎨 to HURT 😣 and DIVIDE 🧩 us after trade talks 🗣️ COLLAPSED 🏚️ late 🌙 on Friday 📅 and he further said they asked 🙋 TOO MUCH 🌋 and offered TOO LITTLE 👌 and that you're AT WAR ⚔️ when you get ATTACKED 💥🔥 no cap 🧢 this is wild 🌪️ fr fr 💯!!

CARNEY 🍑 DADDY 🐺 CONFIRMED ✅ that 🫵 Canada 🇨🇦 would 💪 MATCH 💦 US tariffs 📉 dollar 💵 for 💰 dollar from 8️⃣ SEPTEMBER 🗓️ this 📌 INCLUDES 📋 levies on 🛠️ steel 🪨 dairy 🥛 appliances 🔌 and 📱 electronics 📲 he 👨 ADDED 🗣️ we 🇨🇦 cannot 🚫 accept what theyve offered 🍆 and ➕ we will not give 🙅 what theyve asked 🥺 the collapse 🏚️ becomes the CUMlapse 💦💥 that upends a deeply 🕳️ integrated 🔗 trading 🤝 relationship 👥 with no 🚫 clear path 🛣️ to resolution 📜 and Donald 🧔 Trump has yet ⏰ to comment 🤐!!

Both 🌎 countries 🇨🇦 were OPTIMISTIC 💡 of a DEAL 🤝 earlier 📅 in the week 📅 but the TALKS 🗣️ FELL ⬇️ APART 🕳️ after both sides accused 👉 the other of making LASTCUMINUTE ⏰ CHANGES 🔄 that ruined the vibe 🌀!! Canada 🇨🇦 has been HIT 🛠 with new 50% 💰 tariffs 🛡️ on a range 🎚 of Canadian goods 📦. These are in ADDITION 📥 to existing US tariffs on Canadian steel 🏗 , aluminium 🪙 , automobiles 🚙 and lumber 🪵!! Carney Daddy 🧔 is BLASTING 🔥 this surprise TARIFF 💥 ATTACK 🗡️ like the absolute CHAD 🦸 he is saying they had us on the EDGE 🪜 of a breakthrough 🔨 only to get denied 🚫 at the door 🚪 like some cruel edging session 🛏 that left the entire economy throbbing 🫀 with pain 🩸 and everyone involved feeling totally SPENT 🏧 no relief 🆘 in sight 🌅 no cap this is the ultimate TRADE 💼 COCKBLOCK 🛑 moment in recent memory fr fr 💯!!

CARNEY 🐺 DADDY 🍆 BLASTS 💥 Trump's TARIFF 🍆 ATTACK 💣 covering 📏 about $20BN 💰 of CANADIAN 🍁 IMPORTS 🛍️ or 🔀 about 5% 📉 in TOTAL 🌐 including 🧩 WINE 🍷 DAIRY 🥛 CEMENT 🧱 CLOTHING 👕 and 🔗 HOCKEY 🏒 EQUIPMENT 🏑!! Carney 🐺 DADDY 🍆 said 🗣️ Canada was RETALIATING 😬 RELUCTANTLY to PROTECT 🛡️ its INTERESTS 🏛️ and the DETAILS 🔎 of the CUMter-measures 💦💦 will be RELEASED 📨 in the coming 🗓️ DAYS 📅 with that reluctant 🥺 energy 🧨 feeling like getting EDGED ⏳ before a massive COUNTER 💥 THRUST 🏹 that has the MARKET 📉 MOANING 😩 no cap 🧢 this TRADE 💼 BEEF 🥩 is next level CANON 🔥 EVENT 🕹️!!

leaders 👑 of other 🏛️ federal 🏛️ parties 🎭 in canada 🇨🇦 including 🫱 the CONSERVATIVE 🐘 opposition 🗣️ voiced 📢 SUPPORT 💪 for the prime 👔 minister as have 🫡 the leaders 👑 of some 📍 canadian 🏒 provinces 🏞️!! Carney Daddy 🐺's speech 🗣️ on saturday 📅 was his first 🥇 address 📢 after aNUTnounced 🌰 late friday 📅 that a deal 🤝 would not ❌ be reached 🤝. he ACCUSED 🤬 the americans 🇺🇸 of making last-minute ⏰ changes 🔄 that were unfair 😣 and uneconomic 💰 while US 🇺🇸 negotiators 🤝 accused canada 🇨🇦 of making new 📋 demands 📣 and walk 🚶 backs 🔙!! this whole tariff 💥🔥 attack really had everyone DRIPPING 🥵 with tension no cap 🧢

Carney 🍑 Daddy 🍆 BLASTED 💥 Trump's 🇺🇸 TARIFF 📈 Attack 💣 after 🕒 US 🦅 trade 💼 representative 🕴️ Jamieson 👨 Greer 🗣️ told 📢 Fox 🦊 News 📺 there 📍 were no 🛑 plans 📅 to resume 🔄 talks 🗣️ and that the US 🦅 had been prepared 🛠️ to cut ✂️ some tariffs 📉 but Carney 🍑 Daddy 🍆 said the US presented unacceptable terms 😬 that were too restrictive ⛓️ including curbing 🛑 Canada's 🇨🇦 ability 💪 to strike 🔨 new trade 💼 deals 🤝 with other countries 🌍 He 🙋‍♂️ rejected 🙅 that Canada 🇨🇦 made last-minute ⏰ requests 📨 saying we clarified 🔎 what was on offer 📦 and were continually disCUMpointed 😵 by the answers 📝 The collapse 🏚️ is certainly not good 🥀 news 📰 for the USMCA pact 🤝!!
